name: Login / Start Shift
fields: Guard name, assigned gate, shift status. A guard cannot switch gates unless the administrator permits.

name: Home / Gate Dashboard
buttons: Scan Pass, Register Visitor, Pending Approvals, Check Out
fields: Active gate (Gate 1 or Gate 2), guard identity, connection status, counts of visitors inside and pending approvals.

name: Scan Visitor Pass
fields: Camera QR scanner. Outcomes: Valid, Expired, Already Used, Not Found, Needs Verification.

name: Visitor Details / Registration
fields: Visitor name, phone, destination flat/resident, category, purpose, photo, identity details where required.

name: Permission & Approval Status
buttons: Send Approval Request, Call Resident, Refresh Status
fields: Visitor details, destination flat, pass/pre-approval status, resident availability, current decision (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Expired).

name: Entry Decision / Check-In
fields: ALLOW ENTRY or DO NOT ALLOW ENTRY with the reason; timestamp, gate, guard, category, decision source.

name: Visitors Inside / Check-Out
fields: Active visits by visitor, flat, category, entry time. Overdue visits flagged.

name: Delivery / Parcel at Gate
fields: Delivery company/person, recipient flat, parcel reference or photo, time received, holding status, handover/collection.

name: Recent Activity / Help
fields: Recent entry/exit and parcel events for the current gate. Optional; may be a tab or section.

name: Home
buttons: Approvals, Pre-approve a guest, Visitor history, Parcels
fields: Flat, resident name, count of visitors waiting for approval, count of parcels at the gate.

name: Approvals
fields: Visitor requests sent by the guard that are waiting for the resident.

name: Visitor Request
fields: Visitor name, category, purpose, gate, time asked, photo.

name: Pre-approve a Guest
fields: Guest name, phone, category, visit date, valid until, purpose, pass use.

name: Guest Pass
fields: Pass QR, guest, category, pass id, validity.

name: Visitor History
fields: Visits to the flat with category, gate, status and time.

name: Parcels at the Gate
fields: Parcels held at the gate for the flat, with company, received time, gate and status.
